settings.reset.caches.title: Clear school caches and resync
settings.reset.caches.hint: Use this when school data looks wrong or after changing school accounts.
settings.reset.caches.signOut: Also sign out of school web pages
settings.reset.caches.signOutHint: Saved logins stay, so the app signs in again before it syncs.
settings.reset.caches.downloadsHint: Files show as not downloaded and download again when opened. Notes are never deleted.
settings.reset.full.title: Full reset
settings.reset.full.hint: Return this device to its first-launch state.
settings.reset.full.acknowledge: I understand that my data on this device will be deleted and cannot be restored here.
settings.reset.full.cloudQuestion: Cloud sync is on. After the reset:
settings.reset.full.restoreHint: Your cloud copy is pulled onto this device again.
settings.reset.full.newDeviceHint: Cloud sync stays off. Your cloud copy is kept and nothing is deleted there.
settings.reset.full.restoreFailed: This device was reset, but the cloud copy could not be restored. Pull it from Backup.
settings.reset.item.schoolData: LMS and Kyomu Web records: courses, assignments, materials, registrations and grades
settings.reset.item.catalog: The course catalog, its search index and syllabus details
settings.reset.item.references: Official reference data: calendar, important dates, exams and class schedules
settings.reset.item.userData: Plans, events, planned courses, assignment marks and course edits
settings.reset.item.courseFolder: The course folder on your disk, with notes and downloaded files
Help me set up opens the school website. Sign in manually if needed; the app then reads the new OTP setup, submits its verification code, and saves it after the school confirms registration.
An existing registration requires reset: An existing registration requires reset confirmation. After a reset, replace the school entry in every other authenticator using the new setup saved in this app.
Import an exported TOTP QR code, setup l: Import an exported TOTP QR code, setup link or Secret key using the controls here. If your authenticator cannot export, Help me set up can reset the school registration.
Manual imports need the setup link or Se: Manual imports need the setup link or Secret key, not the changing six-digit code. Press Connect to save a manual import.
App Authentication is already registered: App Authentication is already registered at school. Reset it? The old OTP setup will stop working. After automatic setup finishes, show the new setup as a QR code in this app, or copy it, and replace the school entry in every other authenticator.
School OTP is configured and saved.
Could not finish OTP setup. Check the sc: Could not finish OTP setup. Check the school page and try again.
Scan this with any authenticator app. If: Scan this with any authenticator app. If you reset OTP at school, the old school entry in your other authenticators no longer works: delete it and use this one.
Anyone who sees this QR code can generat: Anyone who sees this QR code can generate your verification codes. Close it when you are done.
If you reset OTP at school, the old scho: If you reset OTP at school, the old school entry in your authenticator no longer works: delete it and add this one.
No authenticator app on this device can: No authenticator app on this device can add this setup. Copy it instead.
